text:
The net yield of ATP by substrate-level phosphorylation is 2 per glucose and 3 per glucosyl unit released from glycogen. Glucose spends two ATP (hexokinase and phosphofructokinase) and later forms four (phosphoglycerate kinase and pyruvate kinase); glycogen reaches glucose 6-phosphate without the hexokinase ATP, so only one ATP is invested and the net is 3.

CONFIDENCE: 92
